RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

The panel's demographic makeup alone does not indicate bias; committee appointments usually reflect internal administrative roles, subfield representation, or availability. While diversity considerations can influence institutional priorities, lecturer appointments depend heavily on departmental fit, interview performance, teaching evaluations, and specific profile needs—such as the successful candidate's industry background.

Alleging gender bias without concrete evidence of procedural violations or discriminatory conduct will almost certainly be dismissed and could severely harm your professional reputation and future job prospects. 

Two weeks is also a common administrative delay in academia. Instead of raising discrimination, send a polite follow-up inquiry focusing strictly on requesting constructive feedback to help strengthen your future applications.
